disposition_reason: Tables 1-3 print dry-weight means of up to 24 elements, including As, Cd, Cr, Ni and Pb, for eight highbush cultivars, commercial blueberries of nine origins and wild bilberries from four Northern European countries.

study.design: compositional and isotope survey of cultivated, commercial and wild Vaccinium berries
study.origin: cultivars from one organic farm on peat soil in Latvia (2018); commercial berries labelled from Peru, Argentina, Uruguay, Chile, Morocco, Spain, Germany, Poland and Latvia; wild bilberries from 26 sites in Latvia and three sites each in Norway, Finland and Lithuania
study.market: commercial samples from supermarkets (Latvia implied by author affiliation; not stated explicitly), 2018-2020
study.method: lyophilised, microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion, ICP-OES (iCAP 7000 series)
lod: 1-10 ppb for Al, Ca, Fe; 0.1-1 ppb for Mg, K, Na; 0.1 ppb for all other elements (solution basis)
study.qa: NIST SRM 3287 Blueberry (fruit); difference from reference values generally below 15% for all elements
